## Questions

1. Approve or reject identity, audit, tombstone and subject retention classes.
2. Resolve deletion, backup expiry and partial-retention truthful reporting.
3. Approve recovery notices, closure grace and cancellation semantics.
4. Resolve support access, purpose limits and dual control.
5. PO-13 is approved as Product Owner Option A (2026-11-26): withdraw
   “fully primium type” as non-operative. It does not cancel or define future
   PARMAR Premium and introduces no subscription, billing or entitlement scope.

## Acceptance criteria

APPROVED requires explicit retention, notice and deletion evidence with
custodian ownership. Existing policy direction alone is not final legal approval.
